output.rationale: The requirement specifies a need for liquid cooling at both rack and chip levels for a minimum of 120kW per rack. The product 'JETCOOL-CDU' addresses the rack-level liquid cooling requirement, as it is a coolant distribution unit designed for high-density racks up to 120kW. The product 'JETCOOL-PLATE' addresses the chip-level cooling requirement, as it provides direct-to-chip cold plates for liquid cooling of high-power processors. These products together meet the technical requirements specified.
